title: AnyList Grocery List Failure Rate
dataSources: Mealime meal plans (`mealime:plan`), AnyList grocery lists (`anylist:grocery`), Instacart orders (`instacart:order`), Paprika recipes (`paprika:recipe`), and pantry inventory counts (`pantry:inventory`).
app: Mealime weekly plans, AnyList grocery lists, Instacart order history, Paprika recipe exports, and pantry inventory scans ingested into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anylist:grocery
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(list_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by store_name
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often AnyList grocery list records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each store.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize list_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per store.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your AnyList grocery list data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
